title: Upsell technical journey mapping and pricing trials
content:
Summary:
This is a working playbook and QBR-adjacent template focused on technical-driven expansion: converting high-volume hosted API customers to Dedicated / Private deployments and selling premium SLA add-ons. Aim: create repeatable checklists, a short QBR / renewal slide outline that highlights the technical case, and a lightweight renewal tracker for CS and solutions engineers to run short pricing trials and migration POCs.

Audience:
- Customer Success Managers (CSMs)
- Solutions Engineers (SEs)
- Account Execs (AEs) for commercial alignment
- Product/Infra for gating migration items

Goals / success metrics (for a single account engagement):
- Technical validation completed (POC) within 4 weeks
- Clear unit-cost delta vs hosted within 2 weeks of telemetry analysis
- Signed Dedicated or Private pilot contract or SLA add-on within 8 weeks
- Actionable rollout plan for traffic migration and rollback prepared

One-line expansion thesis (internal):
Customers upgrade when the marginal value of predictable latency + cost control + data isolation exceeds the friction of migration and commercial uplift. Focus technical narrative on predictable p99 latency, KV cache reuse, and cost-per-token delta at scale.

QBR / Renewal slide template (single-page outline for 15-minute exec slide):
- Title: Customer name — Usage snapshot & expansion recommendation
- Current state: monthly tokens, peak RPS, SLA incidents in last 90d
- Pain statement: cost volatility, occasional degrads, data residency needs
- Technical evidence: sample tail-latency chart (p50/p95/p99), billing heatmap, batch/cache hit ratios
- Proposal: Dedicated/Private + target GPU profile + SMA (SLA) level; expected cost delta numeric example
- Migration runway: weeks, required SE touchpoints, top-3 technical blockers
- Commercial ask & options: pilot vs reserved commit vs full migration
- Next steps: concrete dates and owners

Renewal and trial tracker (compact text table - copyable into a sheet):
- Account | CSM | SE | Current monthly tokens | Target SKU (dedicated/private) | Trial start | Trial end | Key success metric | Status | Next action
- Acme Corp | Priya R. | Marco R. | 12.5M | Dedicated-2xA100 | 2025-11-15 | 2025-12-13 | p99 <= 150ms, cost delta -20% | trial-scheduled | SE-runbook review 2025-11-12

Playbook: Phases and checklists
1) Pre-qualification (CSM + AE)
  - Confirm commercial trigger: forecasted token growth > 3x in next 6 months OR security/regulatory requirement for VPC/on-prem.
  - Capture top-3 use cases producing heavy load (batch generation, embeddings, rerank).
  - Collect sample payloads and peak RPS logs (7 day window). Request in Slack #cs-data-requests.
  - Quick cost sanity: run local estimate using last 30d token breakdown (ops template in linked_artifacts).

2) Technical assessment (SE lead, <1 week)
  - Run inference profile: typical sequence length, kv-cache reuse, streaming vs full-responses.
  - Generate a latency POC on a small Dedicated pool (2–4 GPU) with representative workload.
  - Validate model compatibility (quantization profile, kernels) with infra team. Note any custom model ops.
  - Security checklist: data egress, KMS requirements, audit log retention.
  - Deliverables: POC report, cost projection doc, risk register.

3) Pilot / Trial (2–4 weeks)
  - Pilot scope: 10–25% production traffic routed to Dedicated or Private cluster.
  - Metrics to measure: p50/p95/p99 latency, error rate, tokens/hour, cost per 1k tokens, cache hit rate.
  - Weekly sync cadence with customer + internal war room (CSM, SE, infra on-call).
  - Escalation path pre-defined (SRE lead contact + fallback to hosted variant).
  - At trial end: scorecard (pass/fail per metric), recommended SKU and commit level.

4) Commercial handoff & rollout planning
  - Prepare migration playbook: traffic cutover runbook, monitoring dashboards, rollback steps, post-cutover smoke tests.
  - Negotiate commit terms: commit length, burst allowances, SLA tier add-ons (e.g., 99.9% vs 99.95%), pricing band for model families.
  - Draft SOW for Private deployment if needed (timeline, infra readiness, access windows).

5) Post-migration validation (30 days)
  - Verify cost delta vs estimates; reconcile differences and agree minor credits if misforecasted.
  - Capture performance SLAs and weekly health checks for first 30 days.
  - Customer success checklist: runbook handed over to ops, training for customer engineers.

Technical runbook checklist (SE template snippet)
- Account-specific config: pinned model version, tokenizer config, quantization settings
- Network: VPC peering checklist, firewall rules, routing, NAT egress rules
- Secrets: KMS key ARN, access policies, rotation cadence
- Data handling: retention TTL on logs, PII masking scope, audit log enabling
- Observability: enable RT token-level tracing for pilot, set alert thresholds for p99 and error-rate

Risk register (top items to track)
- Unexpected model incompatibility (non-supported ops) -> Mitigation: fallback model variant + runtime shim work
- Higher-than-expected tokenization causing cost delta -> Mitigation: sequence-length profiling + prompt refactor suggestions
- Network egress or peering delays -> Mitigation: dry-run of VPC peering in staging, timing window with customer network team
- SLA delta disputes -> Mitigation: instrumented measurements for p99 and clear measurement window definition

Outbound cadence templates (short sequences)
- Week 0 (Intro): Hi <Name> — quick QBR follow-up: we ran numbers on your last 30 days and see a 3x cost tail. SE can run a focused 2-week pilot to validate Dedicated vs hosted economics. Can we schedule 30m? (CSM + AE cc)
- Week 1 (Technical nudge): Sharing pilot plan and preliminary runbook. Need sample payloads and NAT details.
- Week 3 (Pilot check): Pilot midway note with p95/p99 snapshot and ask for permission to extend if needed.

Example short email for SLA upsell (to exec sponsor)
Subject: Proposal — Premium SLA and Dedicated baseline for <Customer>
Hi <Sponsor>,
We recommend upgrading to Premium SLA (99.95%) on a Dedicated pool to support your peak inference windows and legal controls. Based on pilot telemetry, expected p99 will improve from ~380ms to ~120ms and unit cost reduces by ~18% at scale. Attached brief has options for pilot <= 4 weeks and 3 commercial packages.

Attachments / artifacts to prepare with every opportunity:
- Pilot runbook (this doc snippet)
- Cost comparison spreadsheet (token-level)
- Security & architecture sketch (VPC diagram)
- SLA sample language and metrics definitions

Internal notes / discussion points (to resolve)
- Pricing: when to allow AE to discount pilot vs require full commit? (propose standard pilot credit of 1 month of predicted spend)
- Enterprise procurement: timeline for Private on-prem legal reviews (usually 6–8 weeks) — factor into renewal negotiation
- Product constraints: list of model families currently flagged for non-DPR quantization work.

Action items (current)
- SE: schedule POC cluster and request tokens payload by 2025-11-10 (Marco)
- CSM: confirm stakeholder list and exec sponsor (Priya)
- AE: prepare 3 pricing SKUs and pilot credit clause draft (Asha)

Notes to self / scratches:
- Keep slide template short; execs want one line recommendation + one chart.
- Use example customer anonymized numbers for public-facing case studies.

References: linked artifacts above; slack channels #cs-ops, #solutions-eng for rapid coordination.

This document is a working draft — please add notes inline, update the tracker table rows to match each account, and attach pilot telemetry artifacts to the JIRA ticket when the pilot begins.
